name: KXM Agent Skills Suite
description: KXM command skills that own every top-level kxm command, browser automation skills, and the separate KontextMind knowledge-plane skills

skills.name: kxm
skills.intent: Find the right KXM skill or kxm_* tool for a request and follow the universal safety rules

skills.name: kxm-project-setup
skills.intent: Set up KXM in a repository, review permission changes, run a first workflow, configure, and add shell completion

skills.name: kxm-harness-auth
skills.intent: Check harness installs and auth, update, run the Runtime supervisor, refresh models, admit routes, and use SSH workers

skills.name: kxm-hub-ops
skills.intent: Start, inspect, bind, and stop the hub, read tenant status, and back up or restore its SQLite state

skills.name: kxm-session
skills.intent: Read session and hub status at the start of a session and open dashboard or studio screens

skills.name: kxm-peer
skills.intent: Delegate to, fan out to, await, and answer other KXM agents safely

skills.name: kxm-workflow
skills.intent: Work inside a durable workflow run by recording journal entries, passing checkpoints, and waiting on signed callbacks

skills.name: kxm-definitions
skills.intent: Inspect or edit role definitions, role hosts, and model rosters without granting writer admission

skills.name: kxm-runs
skills.intent: Create, drive, inspect, and cancel local KXM runs, manage worktree lanes, or smoke-test a workflow model-free

skills.name: kxm-context-memory
skills.intent: Recall what the project knows or decided, explain a context footprint, and record Git memory candidates

skills.name: kxm-skill-lifecycle
skills.intent: Turn a repeated practice into a governed skill candidate and record its evaluations

skills.name: kxm-routing-improve
skills.intent: Find what KXM learned, what keeps repeating, and what a model route cost, as reviewed proposals

skills.name: kxm-tasks
skills.intent: Pick a workflow for a request and plan work as goals and tasks with explicit SCM and tracker boundaries

skills.name: kxm-browser-session
skills.intent: Start, attach to, inspect, and release a remote Steel browser session

skills.name: kxm-browser-takeover
skills.intent: Hand a browser session to a human for MFA, login, CAPTCHA, or sensitive consent, then resume

skills.name: kxm-browser-auth
skills.intent: Use stored credentials and authenticated browser profiles safely

skills.name: kxm-browser-explore
skills.intent: Explore a website, inspect its DOM, and map a user flow with agent-browser

skills.name: kxm-browser-verify
skills.intent: Reproduce a UI bug, gather evidence, and write a durable Playwright test

skills.name: kxm-browser-diagnostics
skills.intent: Diagnose Steel connectivity, CDP errors, and timeouts, and clean up orphaned browser sessions

skills.name: kxm-browser-annotate
skills.intent: Capture page sections, attach structured annotations, and hand the changes to an agent

skills.name: kxm-mind
skills.intent: Route a KontextMind knowledge-plane request, not a KXM one, to the matching knowledge-plane skill

skills.name: kxm-query
skills.intent: Search and read a KontextMind mind with provenance when the user names KontextMind

skills.name: kxm-harvest
skills.intent: Draft redacted session learnings into a KontextMind mind when the user names KontextMind

skills.name: kxm-triage
skills.intent: Work the KontextMind review queue when the user names KontextMind

skills.name: kxm-work
skills.intent: Read or update KontextMind tracker work state and handoffs when the user names KontextMind

skills.name: kxm-insights
skills.intent: List or dismiss KontextMind insights when the user names KontextMind

skills.name: kxm-projects
skills.intent: Manage KontextMind mind repositories and members when the user names KontextMind

skills.name: kxm-protocol
skills.intent: Explain KontextMind protocol contracts, trailers, trust modes, and authorization

skills.name: kxm-mind-setup
skills.intent: Connect a machine to a KontextMind server with the kontext CLI when the user names KontextMind
